name: Olivia Rodriguez
bio:
Olivia's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, through a college internship at a local racing team's merchandise department. She quickly realized the power of strategic marketing to elevate a team's profile and attract sponsors. After earning her degree in marketing, she honed her skills at a boutique agency specializing in sports endorsements, working with athletes across various disciplines.

Olivia approaches her role with a data-driven mindset, always seeking innovative ways to engage fans and build brand loyalty. She's particularly adept at leveraging social media to create compelling narratives and foster a sense of community. What sets Olivia apart is her ability to blend analytical rigor with creative flair, ensuring that marketing campaigns are both effective and memorable. She is eager to contribute to a team's success both on and off the track.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair, often worn in a high ponytail
physical.description: Olivia is athletic and always seems to be on the go.

quirks: Always carries a notebook filled with marketing ideas and sketches.
Has a collection of vintage racing posters in her office.
Prefers to conduct brainstorm sessions while walking outdoors.
